title: More Than 1,000 Nuevo Laredo Students Receive Transformación Avanza Scholarships
excerpt: More than 1,000 private-school students in Nuevo Laredo received Transformación Avanza scholarships for the 2026-2027 school year, in a ceremony led by Tamaulipas education secretary Miguel Ángel Valdez García and Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas.
content:
More than 1,000 students at private schools in Nuevo Laredo received Transformación Avanza scholarships for the 2026-2027 school year, according to the Tamaulipas Education Secretariat (SET).

The scholarships were presented at a ceremony at the Centro de Alto Rendimiento in the Nueva Ciudad Deportiva, presided over by SET secretary Miguel Ángel Valdez García and Nuevo Laredo Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas, on behalf of Gov. Américo Villarreal Anaya.

The scholarship goes to parents and guardians of private-school students, from early education through postgraduate level, to support family finances so the selected students can continue their studies, Valdez García said, according to the report.

Also taking part in the ceremony were Samuel Alcantar Varela, head of SET's Unidad Ejecutiva, and María del Carmen Abrego González, SET's coordinator of innovation and strategic projects, along with municipal education authorities.

Source: Blog Informativo / SET, Nov. 16, 2026.
